name: connected_components
author: e2346c64
description: Splits a graph into connected components (groups of nodes linked by some path) using BFS. Use for: Is the graph connected? How many separate parts are there? What is the largest connected part? Which component is node X in, and how big is it? Works on undirected graphs; on directed graphs it returns weakly connected components (directions ignored) - use strongly_connected_components if direction matters. Returns num_components, largest_size, isolated_nodes and the top_k largest components (rank, size, fraction, sample members). Each listed component is registered as a subgraph (its graph_id); result_graph_id is the largest component, so other tools can run on it.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: How many of the largest components to list.

node.description: Optional node id; also reports the component containing this node. Use lookup_node to find ids.
